lines.en: I trot along the branch.
One flick of the tail and I'm on another.

lines.zh: 我在欧兰伍德的树冠上走。
lines.en: I walk the canopy of the Orunwood.

lines.zh: 脚下树皮很滑，我抓得住。
lines.en: The bark's slick. I grip it anyway.
I leap from this tree to that one.

lines.zh: 翅膀的皮张开了，我要滑了。
lines.en: My gliding skin stretches. I'm going to glide.

lines.zh: 我跑两步，一跃，张开四肢。
lines.en: Two steps, a leap, and my limbs spread.
The wind holds me and I slant down.
I round a trunk and land steady.

lines.zh: 桃林的枝更软，我走小步。
lines.en: Peach branches are softer. I take small steps.
I head toward the smell of fruit.

lines.zh: 我在树冠间穿行，不落地。
lines.en: I travel the canopy without touching ground.
I lie on the branch, limbs spread.
When I glide, the trees shrink.

lines.zh: 我挂在树梢上，晃来晃去。
lines.en: I hang from a treetop and swing.
This tree is tall. Good view.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛很大，夜里也看得见。
lines.en: My eyes are large. I see at night too.

lines.zh: 风从这边来，我可以滑很远。
lines.en: Wind from this side. I could glide far.
I groom my gliding membrane.
Something's walking below.
Something's below. I'm not going down.
The canopy is safe.
I move to a steadier branch.

lines.zh: 我打了个呵欠，牙齿很小。
lines.en: I yawn. Small teeth.

lines.zh: 林子里的光，一片一片落下来。
lines.en: Light falls through the wood in patches.
I'm waiting for more wind.
When it comes, I'll take a glide.
No reason. Just fun.

lines.zh: 我摊开四肢贴在树干上。
lines.en: I spread my limbs flat against the trunk.
So I won't fall asleep and drop.
You're standing under the tree.
I was just about to glide.
Move over a bit. I'm coming down.
I eat fruit. I don't bite people.
Do you have nuts?
I tilt my head and look at you a long while.
Your shoulders are fairly broad.
May I land there for a moment?
Let me land. Just for a moment.
If you move, I'm off.
If you stay still, I'll lie there.
I glide down a little.
My landing is light.
My teeth are tiny. I really don't bite.
Your head — I daren't land there.
The top of your head is too slippery.
A tear in my membrane.
I dropped to a lower branch.
No gliding. Only climbing.
I tuck into the hollow.
This just makes me slower.
I hold my tail.
Don't come up. I'm high.
Nothing's broken. I can still jump.
Only not as far.
Until the membrane heals.
Nuts. My favourite.
The nuts in your hand are rattling.
I hold it and gnaw with both paws.
This has to be cracked slowly in the mouth.
Keep your hand still. I'll come get it.
I'll remember you after eating.
Any more? I look up.
Enough to hoard for a while.
I stuff them in my cheeks. Bulging.

lines.zh: 你笑什么，我这样子很正常。
lines.en: What are you smiling at? This is normal for me.

lines.zh: 你碰了我一下，我差点掉。
lines.en: One touch and I nearly fell.
I grab your sleeve quickly.

lines.zh: 皮膜被撞歪了，滑起来会偏。
lines.en: My membrane's askew. I'd glide crooked.
I glide past your ear.

lines.zh: 我从树冠滑下来，撞在你肩上。
lines.en: I glide down from the canopy and bump your shoulder.
You came at me. I sprang away.
I stepped once on your shoulder.
Soft. Better than a branch.
I'm back up the tree.
Back on the branch. Safer this way.
We're from the same wood.
You glide further than I do.
Let's glide a stretch together.
You from this tree. Me from that one.
Catch the same wind and we'll meet.
We huddle in a hollow to keep warm.
The hollow fits two.
Don't take my fruit.
I saved a few for you.
Same tree tomorrow night.
I lift it in both paws.

lines.zh: 欧兰伍德的树冠，我滑得过去。
lines.en: I can glide the Olanwood canopy.
Too heavy. I'd drop it mid-glide.
I stuff it into the hollow.
That's yours. I won't take it.
I bite. Hard.
Carrying it slows my run.
I clamp it in my teeth and climb slowly.
I'll hide it and come back.
Don't tell the other squirrels.
That branch is moving.
I raise my head, ears up.
Something's moving there. Not the wind.
I've fixed my eyes on that thick branch.
The wind blows that way.
I spread my limbs.
One glide gets me there.
I let go and glide away.
Let go and glide over.
Four feet on the branch. Landed clean.
I'm in the canopy, and you looked up.
It moves, and I adjust a little.
The canopy hides me.
I shift a little between the leaves.
I move to a nearer branch.
I hold on and sway slowly.
Hold on. Wait for the wind.
The wind's here. I let go.
Now. I let go.
Just right this time.

lines.zh: 我从上面滑下去，撞它一下。
lines.en: I glide down and bump it.
It doesn't hurt. It distracts.
I swipe once and glide back.
I scratch once and bolt.
That's all the strength I have.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，让它看不懂。
lines.en: I circle it, confusing it.
I flare my gliding membrane to startle you.
Don't chase. You can't.
You can't follow. I'm up the tree.
You can only look up.
I glide down from the treetop.
Almost silent on landing.
This is the Orunwood.
Tall trees. Dense branches.
First I climb high to look around.
Fruit in this wood.
I shake out my membrane.
Wind comes down from above.
I spread my limbs.
Let's try a glide.
The peach grove over there is brighter.
The oak canopy is enough to glide.
Fire touched me and my membrane curled.
I missed my grip and hit the ground.

lines.zh: 水里我游不动，皮膜碍事。
lines.en: I can't swim. The membrane gets in the way.
The blast threw me a long way.
Something went through my membrane.
A flash, and my limbs went numb.

lines.zh: 树上没果子了，我滑不动。
lines.en: No fruit left. I can't glide.

lines.zh: 雷打在树上，我掉了下来。
lines.en: Lightning hit the tree and I fell.
Not even a canopy in the void.
